summary.intent: Fix four medium-severity Entire review findings across two PRs (#570 status-since, #571 pre-v3) with regression tests written first, push signed commits, resolve findings, then run mutation testing on the fix commits and report results in PR bodies.
summary.outcome: All four findings were fixed with failing-first tests, pushed (signed, valid) and resolved in Entire. Mutation testing on both fix commits showed no missed mutants (G: 15 caught, 1 unviable, 1 timeout; M: 4 caught, 3 unviable, 0 missed), and PR bodies were updated.

repo: Changeset coverage must only count direct-child .md files of the changesets directory, matching the loader; nested paths like .changeset/archive/old.md must not match by stem.
Archived pre-mode notes now load with id `pre/<stem>` so they stay distinct from fresh root notes with the same name at pre exit.
Archive naming (`feature.md`, `feature-2.md`, ...) and unfinished-move detection are one walk in archive_slot; an identical note anywhere in the sequence counts as an interrupted move.
The version plan now carries an `inferred` set of packages with commit-inferred bumps, independent of which source wins the bump reason.
main still tracks mutants.out.old until #574 merges, so after cargo mutants runs it must be restored from HEAD and mutants.out removed rather than committed.
Release-preview tests live in the pre_v3_tests binary; there is no release_preview_tests binary.
Workflow for pushes: explicit refspec push, verify with git ls-remote, confirm signature via gh api commit verification, no trailer, then `entire trail finding resolve <trail> <id>`.

code.finding: archive_slot doc now describes returning the first free or already-identical name in the `<stem>.md`, `<stem>-2.md`, ... sequence plus whether it already holds the note.
is_v3 is derived from PreState shape near archive_dir setup and decides whether archived notes get the `pre/<stem>` id.
Plan struct gained an `inferred` field, so every constructor (release_preview, pr_body, snapshot, apply tests, preflight tests) needed `inferred: Default::default()`.
Plan is populated with `inferred: agg.inference_commits.keys().cloned().collect()`, and status.rs consumes it.

workflow: Writing regression tests first and confirming they fail before the fix worked cleanly for all four findings.
Running full gates in the background while starting the next PR's work parallelized the two-worktree workflow.
Mutation test filters must reference existing nextest binaries or the run fails with exit code 4; an in-diff timeout mutant that loops forever counts as detected.

friction: The first G mutants run failed because the filter named a nonexistent test binary (release_preview_tests) and had to be rerun.
The first attempt to edit the PR bodies appears to have needed redoing via separate prbody.sh/prbody.py scripts.
The first G test run needed an assertion fix after checking the preview JSON shape.
open_items: H branch must be rebased onto main after #571 merges, re-gated, and shipped with G's known-limits section.
mutants.out.old remains tracked on main until #574 merges and must keep being restored from HEAD after mutation runs.
